news.store.title: Store and integrations
news.store.body: The Store tab gathers the integrations. Connect one to your Annoy account with the service's API key, when it asks for one. The key stays encrypted in your account. Annoy's integrations in this version: GPT, SteamProfiler and VPNGo.
news.dmIntegrations.title: Integrations in DMs
news.dmIntegrations.body: In the conversation's "+", choose "Add integration". The other person accepts before the integration works. Call it with /command or @Name; the call leaves your app, with your key.
news.serverIntegrations.title: Integrations on servers
news.serverIntegrations.body: The owner installs integrations in the server settings and gives the API key, which stays on the server only. Members with the "Use integrations" permission call them in channels.
news.vpngo.title: VPNGo and SteamProfiler
news.vpngo.body: With VPNGo, each server can connect through a VPN profile, and that server's voice goes only through the VPN. SteamProfiler shows your Steam profile card on your Annoy profile, if you turn it on.
